name: zvid_image_read_header
description: zVid_Image::ReadHeader rejects null arguments, reads the 16-byte image header, and maps header fields into zVidImagePartial metadata.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVid_Image file I/O helper pass.
Reconstruction remains limited because Binary Ninja HLIL renders partial-word temporaries around the 16-byte header stack buffer; the assembly mapping is used as the acceptance evidence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46ed70 validates the null file/image guards, the fread(&header, 0x10, 1, file) provider call, and the field mapping from offsets 0, 4, 6, 8, 0xc, and 0xe.
The dependency frontier has accepted direct callees zVid_Image::SetSize, zVid_Image::SetFormatCode, and zVid_Image::SetHeaderFlagsByte, with fread classified as the provider call.
The native smoke verifies null-argument returns and direct header mapping before rewinding the same fixture for the broader ReadFromFile path.
